```{r dash_aiSummary_Amplify, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)
library(yaml)

# ── Load config directly ──
config <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here("config.yaml"))

# ── Safely read API key ──
api_key <- tryCatch({
  yaml::read_yaml(here::here("secrets.yaml"))$amplify_token
}, error = function(e) NULL)

# ── Feature Toggle ──
ai_enabled <- isTRUE(as.logical(config$ai_summary_enabled)) ||
              identical(tolower(as.character(config$ai_summary_enabled)), "true")

if (!ai_enabled) {

  htmltools::tags$div(style = "display: none;")

} else if (is.null(api_key) || api_key == "") {

  # error_text <- "\u26a0 AI Generated Summary unavailable: api_key not found."
  template_text <- "Enter remarks here.."
  # template_text <- paste(
  #     "==OVERALL PASSED/FAILED==",
  #   "",
  #   "Current run achieved the expected load of **[Virtual Users]** with a throughput of **[TPS]**.",
  #   "An error rate of **[Error Rate]** was observed during execution.",
  #   "Response Time SLA status: **[Passed/Failed]**.",
  #   "Compared to the previous run, performance **[improved/regressed/remained stable]**.",
  #   "Key recommendation: **[Recommendation]**.",
  #   sep = "\n"
  # )

  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;",
    render_observation_panel(chart_id = "ai_perf_summary", initial_text = template_text)
  )

} else {

  # ============================================================
  # 1. BUILD PROMPT
  # ============================================================
  build_prompt <- function(summary_data) {

    # ── Identify current run defensively ──
    all_seq <- sapply(summary_data$runs, function(r) {
      if (is.null(r$sequence_num)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(r$sequence_num)
    })
    current_idx <- if (all(is.na(all_seq))) length(summary_data$runs) else which.max(all_seq)

    current_run <- summary_data$runs[[current_idx]]
    prior_runs  <- summary_data$runs[-current_idx]

    format_run_block <- function(r, is_current) {

      base_info <- paste0(
        "Run ID: ",              r$run_id, if (is_current) " (CURRENT / LATEST RUN)" else " (prior run)", "\n",
        "Test Name: ",           r$test_name, "\n",
        "Test Period: ",         r$start_time, " to ", r$end_time, "\n",
        "Duration: ",            r$duration_mins, " mins\n",
        "Total Virtual Users: ", r$total_users, "\n",
        "Total Transactions: ",  format(r$total_tx, big.mark = ","), "\n",
        "Total Throughput: ",    r$throughput, " tps\n",
        "Passed Transactions: ", format(r$passed, big.mark = ","), "\n",
        "Failed Transactions: ", format(r$failed, big.mark = ","), "\n",
        "Error Rate: ",          r$error_rate, "%\n"
      )

      # ── SLA data only for current run ──
      sla_text <- ""

      if (is_current) {
        basic_sla <- if (exists("sla_results") && length(sla_results) > 0) sla_results[[as.character(r$run_id)]] else NULL
        rt_sla    <- if (exists("rt_sla_results") && length(rt_sla_results) > 0) rt_sla_results[[as.character(r$run_id)]] else NULL

        if (!is.null(basic_sla) || !is.null(rt_sla)) {

          sla_text <- "\nSLA EVALUATION (CURRENT RUN ONLY):\n"

          if (!is.null(basic_sla)) {
            for (rule in basic_sla$rules) {
              status   <- if (isTRUE(rule$passed)) "PASS" else "FAIL"
              sla_text <- paste0(
                sla_text,
                "- ", rule$label, ": actual=", rule$actual, rule$unit,
                ", threshold ", rule$operator, " ", rule$threshold, rule$unit,
                " [", status, "]\n"
              )
            }
          }

          if (!is.null(rt_sla)) {
            rt_status <- if (rt_sla$failed_count == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL"
            sla_text  <- paste0(
              sla_text,
              "- Response Time SLA (", toupper(rt_sla$metric), "): ",
              rt_sla$failed_count, " of ", rt_sla$total_labels,
              " transactions breached threshold [", rt_status, "]\n"
            )

            if (nrow(rt_sla$top_breaches) > 0) {
              breach_text <- paste(
                apply(rt_sla$top_breaches, 1, function(b) {
                  paste0(b["label"], " (", b["breach_pct"], "% over, ",
                         b["actual_rt"], "ms vs ", b["threshold"], "ms)")
                }),
                collapse = "; "
              )
              sla_text <- paste0(sla_text, "  Worst breaches: ", breach_text, "\n")
            }
          }
        }
      }

      paste0(base_info, sla_text)
    }

    current_block <- format_run_block(current_run, is_current = TRUE)
    prior_blocks  <- if (length(prior_runs) > 0) {
      sapply(prior_runs, format_run_block, is_current = FALSE)
    } else {
      character(0)
    }

    sla_instruction <- if (exists("sla_results") || exists("rt_sla_results")) {
      paste0(
        "SLA evaluation data is provided for the CURRENT RUN ONLY. ",
        "Your summary MUST clearly state whether the current run achieved an OVERALL PASS or OVERALL FAIL. ",
        "Use the highlight format ==OVERALL PASSED== or ==OVERALL FAILED== for the overall verdict only. ",
        "Do NOT apply PASSED/FAILED tags to individual SLA rules — only the overall verdict gets highlighted. ",
        "Do NOT evaluate or comment on SLA compliance of prior runs — no SLA data exists for them. ",
        "Treat the overall SLA verdict as the single most important conclusion — lead with it. "
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    comparison_instruction <- if (length(prior_runs) > 0) {
      paste0(
        "Use the prior run(s) solely as contextual reference to indicate whether the current run ",
        "has improved, regressed, or remained stable relative to them. ",
        "Do not analyse prior run(s) independently or give them equal weight — ",
        "they exist only to frame the performance of the current run. "
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    paste0(
      "You are a performance test analyst. ",
      "Your task is to produce a concise executive summary of 4-6 sentences, ",
      "focused entirely on the CURRENT / LATEST run.\n\n",
      "FORMATTING RULES:\n",
      "- All writing MUST be in British English (e.g., analyse, emphasise, behaviour, centre).\n",
      "- Wrap Run IDs, major numerical figures, throughput values, and error rates in bold markdown (e.g., **1,250 req/s**, **0.05%**).\n",
      "- Highlight ONLY the overall SLA verdict using ==OVERALL PASSED== or ==OVERALL FAILED== syntax.\n",
      "- Do NOT use bullet points or headings — present as a single flowing paragraph of 4-6 sentences.\n\n",
      sla_instruction,
      comparison_instruction,
      "\n=== CURRENT RUN (PRIMARY FOCUS) ===\n",
      current_block,
      if (length(prior_blocks) > 0)
        paste0("\n=== PRIOR RUN(S) — CONTEXT ONLY ===\n", paste(prior_blocks, collapse = "\n---\n"))
      else
        ""
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 2. CALL AMPLIFY API
  # ============================================================
  get_ai_summary <- function(prompt, api_key) {
    tryCatch({

      model_id <- if (!is.null(config$ai_model_id) && nzchar(config$ai_model_id)) {
        config$ai_model_id
      } else {
        "19b89d52-23cf-463d-a5bb-c2896a0f8661"
      }

      ai_url <- if (!is.null(config$ai_url) && nzchar(config$ai_url)) {
        config$ai_url
      } else {
        stop("ai_url not defined in config.yaml")
      }

      response <- httr::POST(
        url = ai_url,
        httr::add_headers(
          "accept"       = "*/*",
          "token"        = api_key,
          "Content-Type" = "application/json"
        ),
        body = jsonlite::toJSON(
          list(
            model_id   = model_id,
            messages   = list(list(role = "user", content = prompt)),
            parameters = list(temperature = 0.3)
          ),
          auto_unbox = TRUE
        ),
        encode = "json"
      )

      raw_json <- httr::content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

      if (httr::status_code(response) != 200) {
        return(list(error = TRUE, msg = paste0("HTTP ", httr::status_code(response))))
      }

      parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)

      extracted_text <- tryCatch(parsed$assistant_resp, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(extracted_text)) return(list(error = TRUE, msg = "Could not parse API response"))

      # Strip internal thinking block if present
      if (grepl("---", extracted_text)) {
        extracted_text <- trimws(tail(strsplit(extracted_text, "---")[[1]], n = 1))
      }

      return(list(error = FALSE, text = extracted_text))

    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(error = TRUE, msg = e$message))
    })
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 3. RENDER
  # ============================================================
  prompt    <- build_prompt(ai_summary_data)
  ai_result <- get_ai_summary(prompt, api_key)

  # ── Convert ==text== highlight syntax to styled HTML <mark> tags ──
  summary_text <- if (ai_result$error) {
    # paste0("\u26a0 AI Summary error: ", ai_result$msg)
    template_text
  } else {
    ai_result$text
  }

  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;",
    render_observation_panel(chart_id = "ai_perf_summary", initial_text = summary_text)
  )
}
```
